title: Flow-Based Fmoc-SPPS Preparation and SAR Study of Cathelicidin-PY Reveals Selective Antimicrobial Activity.
summary: Worker-4/worker-6 re-review closed the prior source-review ticket by reopening XML, PDF text, supplementary ZIP/PDF text, locator indexes, and APD6/DBAASP packet rows. Primary Table 1 supports the MIC matrix except for one preserved DBAASP conflict, Table 2 stability was retained separately, and mechanism claims are bounded to indirect structural/context evidence.
adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed owner-layer rework completed for database and final adjudication; remaining limitations are explicit caution findings, not open blocking tickets.
source_review_depth: paper_xml: Table 1 MIC matrix, Table 2 serum stability, Figure 2 analogue structures, Figures 4-5 CD captions, methods sections 4.4-4.6
paper_pdf: pdftotext cross-check for antimicrobial activity, serum stability, CD, and supplementary-data statements
oa_package: package manifest and duplicated OA members checked for XML/PDF/figures/supplement ZIP
supplementary_assets: ZIP opened; embedded PDF text searched for MIC/toxicity/mechanism-changing tables
merged_database_rows: packet linked APD6/DBAASP assay, experiment, and literature JSONL rows reconciled row-by-row

materials_exhausted.note: Bounded owner-layer recovery exhausted local materials relevant to the worker-4/worker-6 blockers; no missing local source blocks final adjudication.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay/experiment rows were reconciled to Table 1 by peptide/analogue, target, value, and unit; one DBAASPS_20788 P. aeruginosa row remains source_conflict and APD6 AP03602 remains sequence_modified_not_normalized.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Primary Table 1 MIC values for compounds 1-9 were retained with raw values/units/targets/locators; no local hemolysis/cytotoxicity table was present in this paper, and Table 2 serum stability is preserved separately.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are bounded to cation-dependence inference and CD structural context; no direct membrane assay is claimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_final_adjudication: The previous blocking ticket is closed because source review was completed and remaining caveats are explicit, nonblocking cautions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASPS_20788 has one P. aeruginosa MIC database row reporting 2 μM that does not match primary Table 1 values for compound 4; kept as source_conflict in both database snapshots.
APD6 AP03602 explicitly warns that Dab is represented with K; retained as sequence_modified_not_normalized rather than normalized away.
Mechanism language is inferred from cation-dependence and CD structure context; no local direct permeabilization assay was found.
Supplementary ZIP was opened and text-indexed; its PDF contains synthesis and analytical characterization, not additional MIC/toxicity tables.
